subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A' and column
stimulus: 'B' to write five complete sentences. There are more parts of sentences in column 'B' than required. 1×5=5 Column A Column B (a) No other mammal (i) depends on a precise can fly sound system (b) When a sound (ii) by its ears bounces back from an objects (c) The bats radar (iii) the bat can locate is (d) A bat can detect (iv) but mice 10,000 vibrations per second (e) The bat's radar (v) but the bats system is similar (vi) to what airplanes use (vii) to the rudder of a boat
guide_solution: Matching (a) + (v) No other mammal can fly but the bats. (b) + (iii) When a sound bounces back from an objects the bat can locate it. (c) + (i) The bats radar depends on a precise sound system. (d) + (ii) A bat can detect 10,000 vibrations per second by its ears. (e) + (vi) The bat's radar system is similar to what airplanes use.
